outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic of the experimental design, not a data plot; the check does not apply.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression showing mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group (n=4 per group).
Tumor volume plot shows mean with 95% CI, and individual tumor volume data points are plotted for each mouse in each group.
Bar chart of Tmprss11b expression (shRNA) shows mean ± SD with individual data points overlaid for each group (n=4 per group).
This is a line plot of tumor volume over time with SEM error bars; line plots are exempt from the individual data point requirement as overlaying points would make it unreadable.
The quantification bar chart for CD4+ T cell fluorescence shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each field/tumor overlaid on the bars.
The quantification bar chart for pERK fluorescence shows mean ± SD with individual data points (dots) for each field overlaid on the bars.
